name: AMOURTRAUMA: A (bad) Barotrauma Dating Sim
source:
A lonely assistant has a big mission ahead of them. Loneliness and boring submarine life getting to them, can they find anybody to make the upcoming tragedy worth it? Mudraptor aboard, Crawler in the ballast, the possibilities are endless in The Great Sea!

[From [url=https://theshoeburglar.itch.io/amourtrauma]Itch.io[/url]]
